entities.name: Agnethe Davidsen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Agnethe Davidsen was a Greenlandic judge who was the first female government minister in Greenland and only the second female mayor of Nuuk, the capital of Greenland, where she was mayor for more than 14 years until she died suddenly at the age of 60.
